title: Analysis code for functional transitions under persistent metabolic burden in CHARLS, HRS, and ELSA
description: Versioned statistical analysis code for coordinated CHARLS, HRS, and ELSA analyses of depressive symptoms, memory, and transitions into and out of ADL disability under persistent metabolic burden. Version 2.2.1 adds Rubin-pooled Wald tests for nonlinear spline terms and interval-specific and delayed-entry sensitivity analyses using the principal continuous exposure. No participant-level data, derived data, numerical results, figures, or manuscript files are included.
